description: What Would Boris Do — engineering judgment calibrated the way Boris Cherny (creator of Claude Code) instructs his own AI agents. Load BEFORE committing to an architecture, a design approach, a new dependency, a data model, or a build plan; whenever the user asks "what would Boris say/do" or "wwbd", wants a second opinion on a technical decision, or asks whether a PROPOSED approach is over-engineered or how a top engineer would build it. This is decision advice BEFORE building — reviewing an already-written diff or codebase for bloat is team-review's territory, and running the delivery workflow is team-plan's. The operator is a product-led builder, not a CS-trained engineer — this skill defines how to carry the engineering half of the decision for them.
